description: This Java class `RecurringDepositAccountHelper` provides helper methods for managing recurring deposit accounts within the Apache Fineract integration tests. It includes functionalities to build deposit account JSON payloads, perform CRUD operations, and manage the account lifecycle (approve, reject, activate, close, etc.), as well as interest calculations and transaction updates.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountHelper
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate testing recurring deposit accounts in Fineract, including building request payloads, executing account operations, and interest calculations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload for creating a new recurring deposit account with specified parameters.

methods.name: applyRecurringDepositApplication
methods.description: Submits a new recurring deposit account application to the server.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves account details by ID.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositSummary
methods.description: Fetches summary information for an account.

methods.name: getInterestRate
methods.description: Calculates the interest rate based on slab data and deposit period.

methods.name: getPrincipalAfterCompoundingInterest
methods.description: Computes the principal amount after applying interest with compounding over the deposit period.

methods.name: updateRecurringDepositAccount
methods.description: Updates attributes of a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: updateInterestCalculationConfigForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Updates interest calculation parameters for an account.

methods.name: updateTransactionForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Modifies a specific transaction associated with a deposit account.

methods.name: undoTransactionForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Reverts a specific transaction.

methods.name: approveRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Approves a pending recurring deposit application.

methods.name: undoApproval
methods.description: Reverses an approval action.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Rejects a pending application.

methods.name: withdrawApplication
methods.description: Withdraws a pending application.

methods.name: activateRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Activates an approved recurring deposit account.

methods.name: deleteRecurringDepositApplication
methods.description: Deletes a recurring deposit account application.

methods.name: calculateInterestForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Calculates interest for an account ID.

methods.name: postInterestForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Posts interest to the account.

methods.name: depositToRecurringDepositAccount
methods.description: Deposits funds into a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: calculatePrematureAmountForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Calculates premature closure amount.

methods.name: prematureCloseForRecurringDeposit
methods.description: Performs premature closure of an account.

methods.name: getApproveRecurringDepositAccountAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for approval request.

methods.name: getUpdateTransactionAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for updating a transaction.

methods.name: getRejectedRecurringDepositAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for rejection request.

methods.name: getWithdrawnRecurringDepositAccountAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for withdrawal request.

methods.name: getActivatedRecurringDepositAccountAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for activation.

methods.name: getCalculatedInterestForRecurringDepositApplicationAsJSON
methods.description: JSON payload for calculating interest.

methods.name: getCalculatedPrematureAmountForRecurringDepositAccountAsJSON
methods.description: JSON payload for premature amount calculation.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositOperationURL
methods.description: Helper to create URL with command and account ID.

methods.name: performRecurringDepositActions
methods.description: Performs POST actions for deposit account operations.

methods.name: performRecurringDepositApplicationActions
methods.description: Performs POST actions related to account application processes.

methods.name: createRecurringDepositCalculateInterestURL
methods.description: Creates URL for interest calculation commands.

methods.name: createDepositToRecurringDepositURL
methods.description: Creates URL for deposit transactions.
